pages.text: A backpack goes in your back slot and opens with $(bold)B$(). It can be upgraded and dyed, and stays on your corpse like everything else. Supplementaries' sacks are the cheap alternative: a block of storage you can carry.
pages.title: Backpack

pages.text: $(bold)Shulker boxes$() are late. Before them: sacks, backpacks, chest minecarts, wagons, ships. Create's chutes and belts move things between machines; wagons move them between towns.$(br2)A $(bold)toolbox$() (Create) holds tools and swaps them into your hand.
Toolboxes are shared within range: open one and your hotbar can pull from it.

$(bold)Crafting from your chests:$() the Workshop's crafting tables (any wood) see the chests and barrels around them, and EMI's craftable filter counts what is in them. For a whole storeroom, Tom's Simple Storage: an inventory connector touching the chests, a crafting terminal on it.$(br2)$(bold)Storage Drawers$() hold one item each in bulk, show it on the front, and feed Create funnels and belts directly.
